text:
In a long session Codex starts suggesting things you already tried an hour ago. Two lines on GPT-6 Astra stop that.

Put them in ~/.codex/config.toml:

[features.context_management]
experimental_mode = true

Restart Codex and it keeps notes as it goes. https://t.co/2vcjxysJ67
